spans.label: Imported plonky2, Poseidon and limb-trait implementations
spans.note: `use` lines pull in plonky2 builder/proof APIs, the Poseidon and keccak gadgets and the typed limb traits. The model treats all of them as opaque callbacks or premises; no lowering is proved.

spans.label: EXTENDED_PUBLIC_STATE_U64_LEN
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the 48-word length and its 15 + 4*8 + 1 decomposition are pinned as literals.

spans.label: ExtendedPublicStateError variants
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the parse-failure kinds are modeled as a single Fault type shared by the four files.

spans.label: ExtendedPublicState fields
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the six fields (inner public state, block hash chain, deposit hash chain, deposit count, channel-registration chain, bp_sig_chain) are modeled structurally. Source prose about N-of-N semantics is NOT promoted to a guarantee.

spans.label: ExtendedPublicState::new
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the constructor is field-wise and adds no check.

spans.label: ExtendedPublicState::to_u64_vec
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the concatenation order and the resulting 48-word width are modeled, and the encoding is shown to determine every field.

spans.label: ExtendedPublicState::commitment (Poseidon)
spans.note: Poseidon is an opaque callback over the 48 encoded words. No collision resistance or injectivity is claimed; only that equal word lists give equal commitments.

spans.label: ExtendedPublicState::from_u64_slice
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the exact-length check, the cursor offsets and the order of the u63 / u32-limb range checks are modeled, including that the deposit count is checked after the two hash chains.

spans.label: ExtendedPublicStateTarget fields
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the target struct carries the same six fields in the same order as the native one.

spans.label: Target allocation, constants and witness writing
spans.note: builder.add_virtual_* / range-check gadgets / constant materialization / witness assignment are plonky2 boundaries. The `is_checked` flag that gives these wires their u32/u63 ranges is not modeled.

spans.label: ExtendedPublicStateTarget::connect
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; connect is field-wise equality over all six fields, so it pins the whole state.

spans.label: ExtendedPublicStateTarget::select
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; select is modeled as a pointwise branch, not as the underlying arithmetic selector gates.

spans.label: ExtendedPublicStateTarget::to_vec
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the in-circuit encoding order is the same list as the native to_u64_vec.

spans.label: ExtendedPublicStateTarget::commitment (Poseidon gadget)
spans.note: The in-circuit Poseidon gadget and its hash-out-to-Bytes32 conversion are opaque. Agreement between the native and in-circuit hash is a named premise, not a theorem.

spans.label: ExtendedPublicStateTarget::from_slice
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the exact-length assertion is modeled as a panic and the split as pure cursor arithmetic. This path performs NO range validation.

boundaries.name: poseidon_commitment
boundaries.obligation: PoseidonHashOut::hash_inputs_u64 and PoseidonHashOutTarget::hash_inputs are opaque callbacks. Collision resistance, and agreement between the native and in-circuit implementations, must be discharged elsewhere; nothing here derives state equality from commitment equality.

boundaries.name: target_range_allocation
boundaries.obligation: Canonicality of the target limbs (u32 words, u63 block number and deposit count) comes from the `is_checked` allocation gadgets, which are not modeled. The in-circuit from_slice path re-checks nothing.

boundaries.name: inner_public_state_encoding
boundaries.obligation: The 15-word inner PublicState encoding is reused from Zkp.Implementation.BalancePublicInputs; its refinement to src/common/public_state.rs is that module's obligation, not this one's.

boundaries.name: native_target_refinement
boundaries.obligation: No proof relates the handwritten model to the Rust source, to the plonky2 gate lowering, or to Goldilocks field arithmetic.
